# Each -v/-q moves the log level one step from Info. Piling up -q must keep it
# quiet, not wrap around to debug output.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin

# `config diff` logs "in sync" at debug level.
exec sesam -v config diff
stderr 'in sync'

exec sesam config diff
! stderr 'in sync'

exec sesam -qq config diff
! stderr 'in sync'

exec sesam -qqq config diff
! stderr 'in sync'
